technical.summary: COST shows strong bullish structure with price above all key MAs and positive momentum indicators, but overbought conditions (RSI 14: 77.35, StochRSI, Williams %R) and weak ADX trend strength create pullback risk; moderate entry quality suitable for risk-managed swing trades only.

fundamental.summary: No actionable smart money signals detected; insider/institutional activity absent, government contracts and lobbying data unavailable, earnings in 72 days presents timing risk.

sentiment.summary: Mixed signals: Congressional activity is minimal and dated (109+ days old); market fear (44 Fear Greed score) presents contrarian opportunity, but lack of recent news data and weak insider conviction limit conviction.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (459.2), flat yield curve, rising dollar, imminent FOMC event in 1 day, and 72-day earnings window create a highly adverse macro backdrop for equity positioning.

debate.key_bull_argument: Price above all major moving averages with positive MACD crossover and rising momentum (RSI 77.35) provides bullish structure for swing trade entry near support at 497.01.
debate.key_bear_argument: Extreme VIX crisis (459.2), imminent FOMC event in 1 day, overbought RSI/StochRSI/Williams %R exhaustion signals, weak ADX trend strength (12.73), high earnings risk in 72 days, and absent fundamental/smart money conviction create prohibitive risk-reward for entry.
